name: Pick2anki
description: 划词即查：在线多源词典(有道/柯林斯英汉双解/牛津)聚合释义与音标，一键(或自动)通过 AnkiConnect 写入 Anki 指定牌组/模板，支持自定义字段映射与发音音频。Look up English words in your notes and save them as Anki cards in one click. Definitions, phonetics and audio from five dictionaries (Youdao, Collins, Oxford, Bing, Cambridge), with custom field mapping via AnkiConnect. No API key required.
author: soyami
